corridor_notes: Per a 2018-12-13 Sohu news report on the pipeline's commissioning ceremony, the Wanzhou-Yunyang Gas Pipeline runs from Gaoliang First Station (高梁首站) in Gaoliang Town, Wanzhou District, to Yunyang New Station (云阳新站) in Shiyun Village, Shuangjiang Subdistrict (双江街道), Yunyang County -- crossing 2 districts/counties and 8 townships total, including Gaoliang and Tiancheng towns (Wanzhou side) and Bayang, Renhe, Huangshi, and Shuangjiang (Yunyang side). Main trunk length given as 61.15km (close to GEM's 65.00km). Designed daily capacity 1.2 million m3. A separate CNPC article (cnpc.com.cn, URL failed the verifier's liveness screen -- HTTP 412 -- so not cited as a ref, but consistent in content) describes an earlier Phase 1 commissioning on 2017-12-28 at 63.24km with joint investment by Southwest Oilfield Chongqing Kaiyuan Gas Co. and China Resources Gas Co., consistent with the ResearcherNotes' mention of operator 重庆华润凯源燃气有限公司 (formerly 重庆凯源石油天然气安装工程有限公司).
researcher_notes: GEM's EndLocation 'Shuangjiang' is corroborated at subdistrict level (双江街道, Yunyang County). Two apparent phased commissioning dates found in sources (2017-12-28 'Phase 1' per CNPC, 2018-12-13 full commissioning per Sohu) -- both describe the same Wanzhou-Yunyang corridor; not flagged as a conflict requiring action, just noted for context.
